title: Surreal Mosaic Fairy
description: A central woman with large golden butterfly wings stands in a highly detailed surreal fantasy landscape. She wears a mirrored disco-ball mosaic bodysuit covered in flowers, a flower crown, and raises one hand toward a glowing light while surrounded by floating eyes, melting clocks, a golden retriever, a snake, a castle, and various symbolic objects.
prompt: A surreal fantasy scene featuring a beautiful woman with large translucent golden butterfly wings, wearing a reflective mirrorball mosaic bodysuit adorned with colorful flowers and a flower crown. She stands dramatically with one arm raised, surrounded by floating eyeballs, melting clocks, a golden retriever, a red snake, a dark gothic castle, glowing jellyfish, and various symbolic objects in a dreamlike landscape with dramatic orange and teal lighting.
